answer: My proposal for this epoch is a stake bond escrowed per identity. To begin, each address locks collateral before its first answer. After that, the bond is slashed when two keys post the same fingerprint. Every lagoon entry has to back itself with stake, the sable of escrowed funds turns a fake into a liability, and the delta of co-signatures is what a farm can never fake at scale. The cost is concrete: forging 10,000 identities would burn 500,000 USDC in bonds and 30 days of staggered verification. Think of a nightclub that makes every guest leave a 200-dollar coat check.
